run_f_gold: run f_gold(n) to compute the sum of binomial coefficients for row n when n is even
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled by comparing outputs across a set of integer inputs
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which builds a Pascal triangle table and sums row n coefficients for even n
review_f_gold: review f_gold for correctness since the even-index sum logic may have a bug in the conditional
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use math.comb instead of a full Pascal triangle table for better performance
